== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Obi-Wan in Radiant VII (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII.png]]), the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-obiwaninradiantvii-pre.gif]]) and the Master List (2013) show the original text of [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); 11 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not cloak. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” Title as the list prints it: “Obi-Wan in Radiant VII”.
* '''Made:''' 10 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch C1 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
